select count(*) from clinlims.test_section where name = 'Hematopathology'

changeSet.comment: Move Morphology examination (22637-3) to Hematopathology as Peripheral morphology examination
changeSet.sql: update clinlims.test set description = 'Peripheral morphology examination', name = 'Peripheral morphology examination', test_section_id = (select id from clinlims.test_section where name = 'Hematopathology' limit 1), is_active = 'Y', orderable = true, lastupdated = now() where loinc = '22637-3';

update clinlims.localization set english = 'Peripheral morphology examination', french = 'Peripheral morphology examination', lastupdated = now() where id in ( select name_localization_id from clinlims.test where loinc = '22637-3' union select reporting_name_localization_id from clinlims.test where loinc = '22637-3' );
delete from clinlims.sampletype_test where test_id = (select id from clinlims.test where loinc = '22637-3');
